tasks.gr9-letter-of-appreciation-t1: Topic: Writing a letter of appreciation. Cover the purpose (to thank someone for help or advice received), the layout (writer's address and date, salutation such as Dear Mrs Pillay, paragraphs, closing Yours sincerely and the writer's name), the main idea in the first paragraph and supporting ideas (what the person did, what changed, how you feel) in a logical order, a polite and warm register without slang, conjunctions for cohesion (because, so, and, but), a variety of sentence types and lengths, and the writing process (plan, draft, revise, edit, proof-read, present). Use invented names only. Ask Grade 9 learners to identify the purpose, parts and order of the letter, choose the closing, and pick the strong supporting sentence.
